changelog: v1.4.1 — Easy Bids checks first, adds on Gen CV: when the LinkedIn tab shows another job it is read and checked for duplicates (same LinkedIn job id, same company + title, same company this month) — nothing is added and no CV is written just by looking. Easy Apply jobs only. The new Gen CV button adds the job if it is new (stored with its https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/<id>/ link), has ChatGPT write the CV and saves it to Downloads by itself — at once when the job already has a CV.
